--- title: "Time Series Forecasting with Uncertainty" description: "Forecast temperature with conformal prediction bands and compare ConformalForecaster vs QuantileForestForecaster" date: today format: html: self-contained: true embed-resources: true code-fold: true code-tools: true --- # Time Series Forecasting with Uncertainty Forecast temperature using the **weather dataset** (36K+ hourly measurements) with conformal prediction bands. This notebook compares two approaches: - **ConformalForecaster** — wrap any sklearn model, guaranteed coverage - **QuantileForestForecaster** — quantile regression forest, empirical coverage ## Setup ::: {#setup .cell cache='true' execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import polars as pl from sklearn.ensemble import GradientBoostingRegressor from uncertainty_flow.metrics import coverage_score, winkler_score from uncertainty_flow.models import QuantileForestForecaster from uncertainty_flow.utils.split import select_validation_plan from uncertainty_flow.wrappers import ConformalForecaster ``` ::: ## Configuration ::: {#config .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} target_col = "T (degC)" horizon = 6 ``` ::: ## Load Data ::: {#load-data .cell cache='true' execution_count=3} ``` {.python .cell-code} weather = pl.read_parquet("../data/weather.parquet") weather_clean = weather.drop_nulls() print(f"Rows: {weather_clean.height:,} | Columns: {weather_clean.width}") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Rows: 36,887 | Columns: 22 ``` ::: ::: ## Train / Test Split ::: {#split .cell cache='true' execution_count=4} ``` {.python .cell-code} df = weather_clean.select([target_col]) plan = select_validation_plan(df, task_type="time_series", holdout_fraction=0.15, random_state=42) train_ts, test_ts = plan.outer_split split_idx = len(train_ts) print(f"Strategy: {plan.metadata.strategy_name} | Train: {train_ts.height:,} | Test: {test_ts.height:,}") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Strategy: temporal_holdout | Train: 31,354 | Test: 5,533 ``` ::: ::: ## Train ConformalForecaster ::: {#train-conformal .cell cache='true' execution_count=5} ``` {.python .cell-code} ts_model = ConformalForecaster( base_model=GradientBoostingRegressor(random_state=42), targets=target_col, horizon=horizon, lags=[1, 2, 3, 6, 12, 24], copula_family="independent", auto_tune=False, random_state=42, ) ts_model.fit(train_ts) ts_pred = ts_model.predict(test_ts) print(f"ConformalForecaster fitted: {ts_pred is not None}") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` ConformalForecaster fitted: True ``` ::: ::: ## Conformal Intervals ::: {#conformal-intervals .cell execution_count=6} ``` {.python .cell-code} interval = ts_pred.interval(confidence=0.9) print(interval.head(10)) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` shape: (10, 2) ┌──────────┬──────────┐ │ lower ┆ upper │ │ --- ┆ --- │ │ f64 ┆ f64 │ ╞══════════╪══════════╡ │ 0.702901 ┆ 0.84309 │ │ 0.657465 ┆ 0.797655 │ │ 0.582469 ┆ 0.722659 │ │ 0.54692 ┆ 0.68711 │ │ 0.514585 ┆ 0.654775 │ │ 0.484526 ┆ 0.624716 │ │ 0.408438 ┆ 0.548628 │ │ 0.367302 ┆ 0.507492 │ │ 0.323878 ┆ 0.464068 │ │ 0.310495 ┆ 0.450685 │ └──────────┴──────────┘ ``` ::: ::: ## Conformal Forecast Plot ::: {#cell-conformal-plot .cell execution_count=7} ``` {.python .cell-code} actuals_ts = weather_clean[target_col][ split_idx + horizon : split_idx + horizon + ts_pred._n_samples ] fig = ts_pred.plot( actuals=actuals_ts[:200], confidence_bands=[0.5, 0.8, 0.9], title=f"Conformal Forecast — {target_col} (h={horizon})", ) fig ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display} ![](02_time_series_files/figure-html/conformal-plot-output-1.png){#conformal-plot width=1142 height=566} ::: ::: ## Train QuantileForestForecaster ::: {#train-qf .cell cache='true' execution_count=8} ``` {.python .cell-code} qf_model = QuantileForestForecaster( targets=target_col, horizon=horizon, n_estimators=100, calibration_size=0.2, auto_tune=False, random_state=42, ) qf_model.fit(train_ts) qf_pred = qf_model.predict(test_ts) print(f"QuantileForestForecaster fitted: {qf_pred is not None}") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-error} ::: {.ansi-escaped-output} ```{=html}
